cognitive_contract.label: Represent / translate (Standard Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Translate a mathematical structure across distinct representational modalities (geometric reflection to coordinate swap, graphical piecewise locus to zeros, or histogram frequency density to frequency counts).
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to execute the multi-step representation mapping to produce the exact transformed equation, locus, or count W.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the representational bridge invariant without applying the specific translation to the target object.

slots.X: the linear equation and reflection line in Cartesian plane
slots.Y: given original line 2x - 3y + 6 = 0 and reflection axis y = x
slots.Z: coordinate transformation invariant under diagonal reflection: (x, y) -> (y, x)
slots.wrong_idea: confusing reflection across y = x with reflection across y-axis (x -> -x) or origin ((x, y) -> (-x, -y))
slots.replacement_rule: substitute x with y and y with x in 2x - 3y + 6 = 0 yielding 2y - 3x + 6 = 0, rearranged to 3x - 2y - 6 = 0
slots.visual_job: render Cartesian grid with original line, dashed axis y = x, and reflected line
slots.check_job: verify invariant points: intersection with y = x at (6, 6) remains fixed; original x-intercept (-3, 0) maps to reflected y-intercept (0, -3)

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact representation object with clear transformation parameters, options with authentic translation traps
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 representational invariant reminder, H2 tactical mapping step; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; step-by-step why-valid derivation with invariant point check
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student misconception

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative representational path (e.g. slope-intercept transformation instead of coordinate swap)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item with identical representational translation crux

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item with compound or generalized representation translation
